currentObjective: Implement the first real DiagnosticAnalyzer for the isolated ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers project with the BIG9000 infrastructure execution probe only.
decisions: Added ComplexityAnalyzer as a C# DiagnosticAnalyzer under analyzer/src/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers/.
BIG9000 is an infrastructure-only execution probe with Info severity and is disabled by default.
The analyzer registers a compilation action, configures generated code handling explicitly, enables concurrent execution, and reports at most one BIG9000 diagnostic per compilation.
The probe does not inspect methods, loops, LINQ, recursion, call graphs, or complexity patterns.
Analyzer release tracking for BIG9000 is recorded in AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md.
constraints: Do not add ProjectReference or dependency on inherited projects.
Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces or Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces in Phase 1.
Do not add MathNet.Numerics in Phase 1.

Do not implement Big-O analysis, BIG0001, BIG1001, ComplexityExpression, BCL mappings, recurrence solving, call graph analysis, CodeFixProvider, Workspaces, Solver, Engine, or inherited ports in this step.
Package the analyzer assembly under analyzers/dotnet/cs/ and avoid lib/netstandard2.0/ for the analyzer assembly.
validations: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore succeeded in analyzer/ with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
git diff was reviewed before commit.
knownPendingItems: Step 4/5 must add automated tests for the analyzer and BIG9000 behavior.
Future tests must prove descriptor metadata, disabled-by-default behavior, no diagnostics without explicit enablement, and at-most-one BIG9000 diagnostic per compilation when enabled.
Future package/consumer smoke tests must prove the analyzer package can be consumed and BIG9000 can be enabled through .editorconfig.
